scope: Read-only causal timing audit. Explicit local windows and cutoff. Preparation timestamps belong only to the NEXT actual first dispatched request; they do not prove that no other ready work existed, or that all eligibility checks were finished. No time is attributed solely to human review, LLM thinking or network without instrumentation. Checkpoint overlap and import overlap can overlap unprepared/ready intervals and must NOT be summed as disjoint causes.
